Yolande Maritz 4

By: Tarryn Crossman | Paid

Proposal


Show:

Further information:
It’s been nearly 10 years since the first baby died (that we know about) at the hands of Yolande Maritz, and she is still practicing.
How has the south African nursing council, the governing body responsible for holding her accountable, failed all these babies that have died, all these babies that have been permanently damaged.

We take them on, show them the evidence that we have gathered and ask some of the tough questions we have not been able to do, because until now they have refused to go on camera.

The story starts in the room with SANC – the final confront.

And then the story will show how SANC’s failure to stop her has directly resulted in more deaths. Its starts in Bloemfontein
2014 – Baby 1 CP Michelle – reported to SANC
2015 – Baby 2 dies Venetia – Imke gives evidence that she was given Cytotec – reported her to SANC
Gynies in Bloem all reported her to SANC – have the interview – but SANC did nothing

We bring Bloem back into the spotlight, by interviewing these case studies. As a way to highlight that she should have been stopped back then.

From here Carien and Alysia reported her SANC in 2019, again they said they were investigating. While they were investigating, we show what babies were injured and which ones died.

SAPS enter the story here, as this is when the first criminal cases were opened against her. SAPS say that SANC must complete its investigation before it can open a case.

2022 – Her license is finally revoked on only 5 of the cases ever taken to SANC
SAPS Case moves forward, only after her license is revoked, as it could not interfere with SANC’s investigation.
October 2023 – The NPA sends a letter to Afriforum confirming that YM will be charged with six counts of assault in the regional court Pretoria and the matter was now closed. To date she has not been charged – I am still waiting for comms from them.
2024 - Our latest investigation and why are we the ones having to bring the evidence to SANC
We have various case studies to take to SANC?

Script:



She blames shifted from the moment he was born, and she saw he was sick.

Yolandi tried to resuscitate our daughter literally on my chest and they declared my daughter in 1744.

My husband said it felt like he was sending me to the slaughterhouse.

Yolande would give them something called a Rescue Remedy, but it's Cytotec.

The mothers never gave consent because they didn't know what they were drinking.

she was a very evil cowboy who thought she could play God.


FADE TO BLACK

VO
Our first expose into Yolande aired in 2020, and the next in 2021, every story revealing more horrific truths about what was happening in her birthing center, YOU AND ME.
But It wasn’t until 2022 that the South Nursing Council finally took action against Yolande, and revoked her license.
But, In January, we discovered that she is still practicing.

The dude setting up the camera -

VO
In this undercover footage, Yolande can be heard offering to deliver this woman's baby

Yolande - I can do it for 15K, AND then we also bath the baby

VO
WE THEN CONFRONTED YOLANDE DURING THIS STING OPERATION

YOLANDA, WHAT ARE YOU DOING …..
LET THIS PLAY OUT FOR ANOTHER 10’ BEFORE THE VO COMES IN



VO
In the aftermath of this story, more patients came forward to share their stories about Yolande Fouche.

VO
Using these new cases, we traced her career back to Middleburg in Mpumalanga in 2009.
An anonymous mom sent us THIS voice note explaining the traumatic birth experience she had with Yolanda at the time.

Mom - my baby was purple he wasn’t even blue.
The umbilical cord was stuck around his neck.

From Middelburg, Yolande moved to Bloemfontein, where she officially opened her home birthing center, YOU AND ME.
This is where Carien Moller delivered in 2019.

Cariens voice - I was already five centimeters when we got to Yolanda. So halfway there
everything changed then when she told me to get into the bath.
and then she gave me a bottle of water to drink

VO
like almost every patient we have spoken to, Carien remembers Yolande giving her rescue remedy in water, which, according to the staff at YOU AND ME, was Cytotec.


VO
Cytotec, is A dangerous drug used off-script to speed up labor. The danger is that it overstimulates the uterus so much that there is no space between contractions for the baby to get oxygen, and it goes into distress.

CARIEN
I couldn't cope with the contractions anymore.
Between the contractions, there was no break. It was contraction upon contraction.




VO
When Cariens daughter was eventually born, she had to be resuscitated and was later diagnosed with Cerebral palsy, a birth injury caused by Asphyxiation or a lack of oxygen.

VO
Carien has been fighting for justice ever since. I got her on the phone to cross-reference the data we had been gathering with her ever-growing list of victims.

Masa
So, since our last story, more moms have come forward?
Carien
Yes… a lot.

VO
The data before us was much worse than we had ever thought.

VO
In 2014 two babies died,
2015 one baby passed away and one was diagnosed with cerebral palsy.
2017 there was 1 death.
2018 there were 2
2019 there were 3
In 2020, there were three infant deaths and one baby diagnosed with Cerebral Palsy
Of the 62 mothers we managed to get information from 14 babies died and 4 were diagnosed with Cerebral Palsy. But these are just the ones we know about.

BEAT

VO
How did the SOUTH AFRICAN NURSING COUNCIL as the governing body miss this?

Carien and MASA on the phone
It is shocking and frightening.

VO
But Carien was not the first to lay a complaint against Yolande with sanc. Ventia Pretorius contacted them back in 2015…. until today SHE HAS BEEN TOO AFRAID TO GO ON CAMERA


VENETIA
and I remember pushing with everything I had in my body. 00:05:12:03 - 00:05:30:05
And she just said to me, J. You're not pushing, you’re going to make sure your baby doesn't come out alive.

VO
After nearly 12 hours of labour Yolande repeatedly used forceps to get Venetia’s son out of the birth canal

VENETIA
the fourth time she put them in, she said, Just hold on. And my husband gave me my friend kicked my leg on the one side and on the other side, and you landed, just pushed.

And she's she just she to to say she was like, she's tearing. And I remember her cloves being full of blood.

VO
When Venetia’s BABY was finally delivered, he was blue.

VENETIA
he made a funny noise like he was breathing through slime or something in his mouth.

VO
Venetia’s Son passed away a few days later, the official diagnosis was Asphyxiation.
Breath
Soon afterwards, she laid a complaint with sanc

VENETIA
I didn't know exactly what I was looking for at that stage. I just knew that what had happened with my son was an injustice. I knew who should have been that blue.
But I didn't get anything from them.

Masa
So you sent this information to say yes and you get no reaction, no reaction, no response, nothing.
V - Not even a thank you be received it kind of thing. No response whatsoever.

VO
This Midwife, who has asked to remain anonymous, says she tried to report Yolande in 2018 after a baby referred to her died. But SANC wanted evidence they couldn’t provide

- Midwife on the phone - They just made it impossible to Report

Fade to black

VO
Why had SANC ignored these complaints that could have stopped Yolande years earlier? We needed to get some answers from the governing body who have refused to go on camera with us, until now. Mr Benjamin Grobler is the Senior Manager for Legal Affairs at sanc


Masa
When was then first made aware of Yolanda MARITZ?
Nursing Council
We received our first complaint against Yolanda in 2016 from the VOLKSBLAD newspaper.
Masa
This is the case of Venetia, and she says she reported the matter to SANC in 2015 before she went to the media.

Nursing Council
I'm not privy to that information. I don't. LAUGH

VO
Grobler asked to be allowed to consult with his colleagues on Venetia’s case but returned with no further information. According to SANC, Venetia never reported anything. However, they had investigated her case based on a 2016 newspaper article.

Masa
So, what happened with that investigation in 2016?
Nursing Council
THE MATTER was investigated and found to be not nursing negligence on the evidence provided.

VO
SANC had found YOLANDE not guilty with not so much as a phone to Venetia. She only found OUT THAT there was a case after Yolande posted this letter on Social media, stating that she had been found innocent

Masa
So 2016, your investigation finds that everything is okay with this midwife. She continues, and she carries along.
Nursing Council
Sorry, not okay. There was no evidence of unprofessional conduct. She's allowed to practice within a scope of practice and not beyond that
MASA semantics.
Nursing Council
We take all complaints very seriously because our mandate is the protection of the public.

Masa
I'd like to bring to your attention a matter in 2018. There was a SANC MEMBER, a registered midwife.
who was concerned about the number of patients she was seeing coming from Yolanda's care. but she says they weren't taken as seriously as you say.

SANC
we need evidence that we can put before the committee. So a pure allegation without substantiated evidence is very difficult to prove that it was unprofessional conduct.
Masa
But you've got an investigating team. Why didn't you put them onto IT
Nursing Council
We do sometimes do that. If she HAD pursued the matter, then we definitely would have

VO
After finding no evidence of unprofessional conduct in Venetia's case in 2016,
In 2022, SANC called Venetia in to present her case again, and this time, it FOUND YOLANDE GUILT of NEGLIGENCE, Including using forceps, which is outside her scope of practice.


Masa
I just want to look at the timeline here. at the number of babies that had died between that period 2015 there's a dead baby, another baby, 2017, three babies dead. And in 2018, another baby died.
Did you not, at some point GO TO YOU AND ME AND DO AN AUDIT
Nursing Council
We do sometimes have instances where we do investigations at facilities.
Masa
Did you do that? You and me birthing center.
Nursing Council
Not To my knowledge.

VO
4 weeks ago, we provided concrete evidence to SANC that Yolande Fouche is still practicing. It said the information was shared with the HAWKS, but to date, no action has been taken has been taken.
Another system that seems to have failed in its mandate to protect the people of South Africa,


VENETIA
It makes me scared to think that she's still out there carrying on.
I like the idea of ending with the ball scene all soft and her climbing off and leaving the ball there.
















3 x 21’
